届いた対局の人の手を、1手ずつ最強AIで採点しています（対戦ページの「ヒント」と: Every human move in the games received is scored by the strongest AI, the same way as the hints on the play page. A move that loses 3 or more points by the AI's estimate counts as a mistake, and the notes below show where points tend to slip away. They are recounted automatically whenever a new game arrives. The AI's estimates are not exact either, so treat the points for a single move as a rough guide.
